functions.name: TOBS
functions.description: Converts an AD date to a Nepali (BS) date, as text.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional. A format like "yyyy-MM-dd" (default), "D" for 16 Ashwin 2082 or "dddd, d MMMM yyyy".

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional. "roman" (default) or "nepali".

functions.name: TOAD
functions.description: Converts a Nepali (BS) date to an AD date. Format the cell as a date.

parameters.name: bs_date
parameters.description: BS text like 2082-06-16 or 16 Ashwin 2082. A range converts every cell.

functions.name: DATE
functions.description: Returns the AD date of a Nepali (BS) year, month and day. Format the cell as a date.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The BS year, 1970 to 2090.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The BS month: 1 (Baisakh) to 12 (Chaitra), or its name.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: The day of the BS month.

functions.name: YEAR
functions.description: Returns the Nepali (BS) year of an AD date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.

functions.name: MONTH
functions.description: Returns the Nepali (BS) month of an AD date, 1 (Baisakh) to 12 (Chaitra).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.

functions.name: DAY
functions.description: Returns the day of the Nepali (BS) month of an AD date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.

functions.name: FORMAT
functions.description: Formats a Nepali (BS) date, for example in Devanagari or with the month name.

parameters.name: bs_date
parameters.description: BS text like 2082-06-16 or 16 Ashwin 2082. A range converts every cell.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional. A format like "D" for 16 Ashwin 2082, or "d MMMM yyyy". The default is "yyyy-MM-dd".

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional. "roman" (default) or "nepali".

functions.name: TODAY
functions.description: Returns today's Nepali (BS) date, as text.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional. A format like "yyyy-MM-dd" (default) or "D".

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional. "roman" (default) or "nepali".

functions.name: DAYSINMONTH
functions.description: Returns the number of days in a Nepali (BS) month.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The BS year, 1970 to 2090.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The BS month: 1 (Baisakh) to 12 (Chaitra), or its name.

functions.name: MONTHNAME
functions.description: Returns the name of a Nepali (BS) month.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The BS month: 1 (Baisakh) to 12 (Chaitra), or its name.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional. "roman" (default) or "nepali".

functions.name: TONS
functions.description: Converts an AD date to a Nepal Sambat (नेपाल संवत्) lunar date, as text.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional. "G" for NS 1145 Kaula Thwa Dashami (default), "M" without the year, or "Y" for the year only.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional. "roman" (default) or "nepali".

functions.name: NSYEAR
functions.description: Returns the Nepal Sambat year of an AD date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: An Excel date, or AD text like 2025-10-02 or 2 Oct 2025. A range converts every cell.
